item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00336","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C01","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 supplies the child’s distinctive operative template: after identifying a trade-agreement provision tied to an abnormal situation, the President proclaims that the abnormal situation concerning a specified commodity has terminated, thereby activating the agreement’s duty treatment. The child closely adapts this machinery and wording from flaxseed to cattle and meats. C01 is also a strong source for the child’s GATT/Proclamation No. 2761A background recital, while C15 provides a related item-specific modification structure, but neither matches the child’s central termination finding as directly as C10.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"do proclaim that the abnormal situation in respect of cattle and meats referred to in the said first item 701 has terminated","parent_excerpt":"do proclaim that the abnormal situation in respect of the trade in flaxseed which is referred to in the aforementioned trade agreement provisions has terminated","explanation":"Distinctive near-verbatim operative finding, with only the commodity and cross-reference changed."},{"child_excerpt":"and accordingly the first proviso to the said item shall be effective on and after April 1, 1953","parent_excerpt":"with a view to making applicable to flaxseed the rate of duty of 50 cents per bushel of 56 pounds on the thirtieth day following this proclamation, as provided for in said Trade Agreements","explanation":"Both use termination of an expressly referenced abnormal situation as the trigger for specified tariff treatment to become applicable."},{"child_excerpt":"acting under authority vested in me by the Constitution and statutes, including the said section 350 (a) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended","parent_excerpt":"acting under the authority vested in me by the Constitution and statutes, including section 350 of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended","explanation":"The same authority clause supports the parallel operative proclamation."}]}
